post.description: Call this API to register details into KRA.

unique_request_id.description: Unique request id for traceability of request and recon purpose. Businesses are required to pass unique id for every request.

kra_providers.description: list of kra provider (CAMS and CDSL allowed)

uid_no.description:
UID / Aadhaar No of the applicant in case of Individuals only.
Value will be mandatory for E-KYC Transactions.
Only Last 4 Digit is acceptable

dob_date.description:
Date of Birth for Individual
Format to be used is dd/mm/yyyy
01/01/2011
31/07/2011

ipv_date.description: Date should not be greater than the current date. Date will be in dd/mm/yyyy format.

gender.description:
GENDER of the applicant applicable to Individuals only. M → Male
F  → Female
T  → Transgender

occupation.description:
OCCUPATION 01	Private Sector Service

02	Public Sector

03	Business

04	Professional

05	Agriculturist

06	Retired

07	Housewife

08	Student

09	Forex Dealer

10	Government Service

99	Others

per_add1.description: Address line 1 of the applicant. (Character Limit - 55)

per_pincode.description: Permanent/Registered Address Pin Code - (10 digit alphanumeric in case of non-India locations only.)

per_state.description: Permanent/Registered Address State. Details to be entered if the code is 99.

per_add_proof.description: ADDRESS PROOF of Permanent/Foreign/Permanent Address Proof.

pan_copy.description: Pan copy if enclosed or not. (Y/N)

applicant_name.description: Name of the Individual / Entity Name in case of Non-Individuals

father_name.description: Name of the Father / Husband in case of Individual

kyc_mode.description:
e-KYC is applicable only for New Individual KYC     

 0	Normal KYC

1	e-KYC with OTP (Applicable for New Individual only with UID No Mandatory)

2	e-KYC with Biometric (Applicable for New Individual only with UID No Mandatory)

3	Online Data Entry and IPV
4	Offline KYC - Aadhaar (Applicable for New Individual only with UID No Mandatory)

5	Digilocker (Applicable for New Individual only with UID No. Mandatory)

app_rel_per_addr_type_exp_date.description: Relative person address type expiry date

app_exmt_cat.description:
Category under which person or entity is exempt. Mandatory if the PAN Exempt flag is Yes . Possible Values are below.                                                     01 -> SIKKIM Resident
02 -> Transactions carried out on behalf of STATE GOVT
03 -> Transactions carried out on behalf of CENTRAL GOVT
04 -> COURT APPOINTED OFFICIALS
05 -> UN Entity/Multilateral agency exempt from paying tax in India
06 -> Official Liquidator
07 -> Court Receiver
08 -> SIP of Mutual Funds Upto Rs. 50,000/- p.a.
11 -> OTHER DOCUMENTS (Only allowed for Old Records)

update_flag.description:
UPDATE TYPE -> Possible values
01 -> New
02 -> Modify with documents
03 -> Modify without documents
04 -> Dump
05 -> Suspended
06 -> Deceased
07 -> Old KYC Record
11 -> Old KYC Record Modification
99 -> Interop Modification

kra_code.description:
CVLKRA → CVL KRA
NDML     → NDML KRA
DOTEX	 → Dotex KRA
CAMS	 → CAMS KRA
KARVY	 → KARVY KRA
BSE	 → BSE KRA

pos_code.description: RTA to update the POS code of the AMC on whose behalf they are updating the request. All other intermediaries to update their own POS code

app_exmt.description: If a person or entity is exempt for PAN. (Y/N)

app_exmt_id_proof.description:
IDENTITY PROOF Possible Values                          01 -> PAN
02 -> UID NO.
03 -> Passport
04 -> Driving License
05 -> Voter Identity Card
06 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Central / State Government and its Depts
07 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Statutory / Regulatory Authorities
08 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Public Sector Undertakings
09 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Scheduled Commercial Banks
10 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Public Financial Institutions
11 -> ID Card with applicant's photo issued by Colleges affiliated to universities
12 -> ID Card issued by Professional Bodies such as ICAI, ICWAI, ICSI, Bar Council, etc. to their Members
13 -> Credit Card with Photo of applicant issued by banks
16 -> OTHER ID PROOF (Only for old record)

ipv_flag.description:
IN PERSON VERIFICATION FLAG:

Y → Yes

N → No

E → Exempted (Applicable for Online mode KYC and application completed with e-Sign)

31/07/2011

commence_date.description: BUSINESS COMMENCEMENT DATE OF THE COMPANY. If same as date of Incorporation then the date should be the same.

other_nationality.description: NATIONALITY details in case of others

income.description:
GROSS ANNUAL INCOME

01	BELOW 1 LAC

02	1-5 LAC

03	5-10 LAC

04	10-25 LAC

05	> 25 LAC (Only for Individuals)

06	25 LAC - 1 CR (Available only for non-individuals)

07	> 1 CR (Available only for non-individuals)

other_occupation.description: Occupation Description, if OCCUPATIONAL DETAILS IS SET TO Others this field is mandatory.

RPEP → Related to Politically Exposed Person

PEP    → Politically Exposed Person

doc_proof.description:
DOCUMENT SUBMISSION DETAILS                     S  →  Self Certified Copies Submitted (Originals Verified)
T  →  True Copies of Documents Received

internal_ref.description: Internal Reference No for Intermediaries to refer back

branch_code.description: Branch Code to which the KYC is attached to.

net_worth.description: Networth of the Entity (Only Numeric is allowed). This would be non-mandatory for Individuals and non-Individuals.

net_worth_date.description:
Net Worth as on Date. This would be non-mandatory for individuals if the Gross Annual Income has been specified. However, if the Networth has been specified in case of non-individuals then the Networth Date is mandatory. Format to be used is dd/mm/yyyy
01/01/2011
31/07/2011

other_info.description: Any Other Information e.g “”MOBILE NUMBER , EMAIL ID”

vid_no.description: VID (Aadhaar virtual id) of the applicant in case of Individuals only.

uid_token.description:
